name: Commit Message
summary: Turns a diff into a ready-to-paste commit message that explains why the change was made, not just what it does. Uses {{diff}} and {{style}}.
body:
Write a commit message for the change below, in the style of {{style = Conventional Commits}}.

```diff
{{diff}}
```

Rules:
- The subject line states what changed and stays under 72 characters.
- If the change needs more than a subject, add a body that explains why the change was made. The diff already shows what it does; the message must supply the reason.
- Mention any user-visible behavior change, breaking change, or migration step explicitly.
- Output only the commit message, ready to paste. No commentary around it.
